title: Quick-react bar on posts
description:
Long-press or swipe to surface emoji reactions (❤️🔥👀😂) without forcing a full quote/reply. Lowers the bar to interaction.

v0 Acceptance Criteria

1. Reaction write endpoint keyed by (viewer DID, post URI); emoji ∈ {heart, fire, eyes, joy}; 2xx on success.
2. Change/remove: new emoji replaces prior; tapping selected emoji removes it. One reaction per viewer per post.
3. Independent of Like — no cross-triggering in either direction.
4. Native long-press ≥400ms on post body opens bar; release on emoji selects; off-target release dismisses.
5. Light-impact haptic on each successful native selection, respecting system prefs.
6. Web hover ≥200ms reveals a React button; click opens popover; outside click / Escape dismisses.
7. Web keyboard: Tab to React button, Enter/Space opens popover with focus on first emoji, arrows move, Enter selects, Escape closes.
8. Surface scope: PostFeedItem and thread post components only. NOT on quote embeds, search previews, notification items, feed-generator previews.
9. Viewer's chosen emoji renders as a chip inline with post controls; persists across restarts and devices for the account.
10. No aggregate counts, no other-users reactions, no reacted-by viewer in v0.
11. A11y: "React to post" accessibility action opens an accessible picker with localized emoji labels.
12. Reduced-motion: instant opacity fade only; no scale/translate animation.
13. All emoji labels pass through Lingui; no hard-coded English.
14. RTL: emoji order + popover anchor mirror horizontally.
15. Feature-flag gate "quick\_reactions\_v0", default OFF. When OFF: no bar/button/a11y action/network call on any surface. Runtime flip enables without reinstall.
16. Optimistic chip update within 100ms; on failure or offline, revert + non-blocking "Couldn't save reaction" toast, no retry loop.
17. Rate limit: multiple selections within 2s on the same post debounce to one request for the final selection.
18. Analytics on (a) bar open, (b) emoji select, (c) reaction remove with: post URI hash, emoji code, surface, platform, flag variant.

Explicitly out of scope for v0

- atproto lexicon / federation / firehose
- Custom emoji set, skin tones
- Aggregate counts + reacted-by viewer
- Author notifications
- Reactions on DMs, profiles, lists, feed generators
- Quote, embed, search-result, notification-item surfaces
- Swipe gesture (long-press + hover only)
- Reaction-specific moderation controls
- Like button refactor to merge with reactions
- Reactions in composer / reply flow

Specs persisted on the agent:

- .claude/state/PRI2pI7l/ac_product.md
- .claude/state/PRI2pI7l/ux_design.md
- .claude/state/PRI2pI7l/arch_plan.md
